messages:
maria.design: quick thought — interval presets and the sampling slider feel like two separate mental models. users expect time window to control scope and sampling to be a performance knob. can we surface them separately?

sam.eng: +1. current layout puts them next to each other and people toggle sampling thinking they're changing time range. backend supports a separate `sample` param so frontend can split concerns.

raj.product: curious about defaults. if we surface sampling more, what should the default be? 100% could be slow & costly for big ranges. 10% might hide regressions.

lina.pm: proposal: default = `auto` which picks a sample rate based on range and SLO (e.g., shorter ranges -> 100%, long ranges -> 10-25%). include microcopy explaining tradeoff.

dylan.ux: thinking of a small chip next to the timepicker: "Sampling: Auto". clicking opens a popover with radio options: Auto / 10% / 25% / 50% / 100% and a one-line explain copy. also add a tiny "estimated" badge next to p95 when sample != 1.

eva.a11y: accessibility nits: when sampling changes the heatmap we must announce the change via aria-live and keep keyboard focus inside the popover. also the density toggle contrast is marginal WCAG.

sam.eng: backend note: we'll accept `sample=auto|0.1|0.25|1` and translate auto to heuristics. example request:```
GET /api/observability/latency?range=1h&sample=auto
# sample can be auto, 0.1, 0.25, 1
```

maria.design: microcopy drafts: option A: "Sampling reduces the number of points fetched to speed up loading. p95 shown when sampled may be an estimate." option B: "Sampling limits data to speed up the dashboard; enable 100% to recompute exact p95." which reads better?

lina.pm: prefer shorter: "Sampling reduces points to improve load time. p95 may be estimated." also add hover tooltip: "Run full query to verify p95" with a quick action button.

raj.product: add a guardrail: if sample < 1 and the sampled p95 deviates > 15% from a cached full-run baseline, show a warning: "Large discrepancy detected — view full data". helps prevent missed regressions.

dylan.ux: for legend/visuals: reorder legend to show percentiles first (p50, p95), then sampling state. collapse redundant legend items and show an inline tooltip on hover instead. I'll mock both a popover and a compact inline control.

eva.a11y: please ensure the p95 "estimated" badge is programmatically exposed and has an accessible tooltip text. keyboard users should be able to toggle sampling without a mouse.

sam.eng: small implementation nit — default `auto` will map to `1` for orgs on dedicated plans to avoid surprises for enterprise SLAs. others get heuristics.

maria.design: ok action items: dylan -> mock popover + badge (deadline EOD Wed); sam -> API param + server heuristics; eva -> a11y checklist & quick test once mock is ready; lina -> final microcopy and acceptance criteria; raj -> define guardrail thresholds and telemetry events. i'll compile a short handoff doc after mocks land. :thumbsup:

lina.pm: also consider storing per-user sampling preference in local profile for power users (toggle "remember my sampling").

raj.product: yes please — power users will appreciate it. just persist only after explicit opt-in.

maria.design: final design note — we should avoid duplicating the density control with the heatmap opacity slider. if we keep both, hide one behind "advanced" to reduce clutter.

dylan.ux: got it. i'll include both compact & advanced variants in the mock so we can test clarity.

eva.a11y: ping me when the mock is up, i'll run a keyboard + screen reader sanity pass.

maria.design: thanks all — follow-up thread will include the handoff doc and acceptance checklist.
